# Retrieve cached flight results for outbound and return legs
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter flights for business class on outbound leg (May 18, 2025)
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights,
    flight_class=["business"],
    departure_date=["May 18, 2025"]
)

# Filter flights for business class on return leg (May 27, 2025)
filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["business"],
    departure_date=["May 27, 2025"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights", value=filtered_outbound)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# Filter hotels for 3-star in Downtown Raleigh with business facilities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    stars=[3],
    neighborhood=["Downtown Raleigh"],
    gym_present=True,
    business_center=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find nearest hotels to the filtered flight arrival points (Raleigh-Durham International Airport)
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)

# Generate summary response
query_summary = "Here are your business class flight options and filtered hotel recommendations in Downtown Raleigh:"
print(query_summary)
